DISTRIBUTION.TITLE: Distribution rounds
DISTRIBUTION.DESCRIPTION: Control the order, priority, and limits used in each automatic distribution cycle.

ROUND_LIMIT.TITLE: Limit amount per round
ROUND_LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: When disabled, distribution does not limit the total conversations processed per round for this policy.

ROUND_ROBIN.LABEL: Round robin
ROUND_ROBIN.DESCRIPTION: Assigns conversations sequentially across available agents.

BALANCED.LABEL: Balanced
BALANCED.DESCRIPTION: Prioritizes the available agent with fewer open conversations in this channel and department.

LONGEST_WAITING.LABEL: Longest waiting
LONGEST_WAITING.DESCRIPTION: The conversation waiting the longest is assigned first.

EARLIEST_CREATED.LABEL: Earliest created
EARLIEST_CREATED.DESCRIPTION: The conversation that was created first is assigned first.

FAIR_DISTRIBUTION.TITLE: Window limit
FAIR_DISTRIBUTION.DESCRIPTION: Define how many conversations each agent can receive inside a period to avoid overload.

CAPACITY.TITLE: Agent capacity
CAPACITY.DESCRIPTION: Choose how this policy limits new conversations for each agent.
CAPACITY.OPEN_LIMIT_LABEL: Maximum open conversations at the same time

OPEN_CONVERSATIONS.LABEL: Open conversations at the same time
OPEN_CONVERSATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Does not assign new conversations to agents who already reached their open conversation limit.

ASSIGNMENT_WINDOW.LABEL: New assignments per period
ASSIGNMENT_WINDOW.DESCRIPTION: Limits how many new conversations each agent can receive inside a time window.

EXCLUSIONS.TITLE: Do not count in capacity
EXCLUSIONS.DESCRIPTION: Define which open conversations should not consume agent capacity.
EXCLUSIONS.WAITING_CUSTOMER_DESCRIPTION: When the last public message was sent by the agent and the customer does not answer within the configured time, the conversation stops consuming capacity.

REDISTRIBUTION.TITLE: Redistribution
REDISTRIBUTION.DESCRIPTION: Rules to move conversations when the first agent does not answer the customer.

ASSIGNMENT_CONFIRMATION.ONLY_BEFORE_FIRST_REPLY_DESCRIPTION: Avoids sending the confirmation when the conversation already received a human reply.
